summary_for_children: An-Nazi'at tells of Musa called in the valley of Tuwa and sent to Pharaoh, and shows how Allah raised the sky and spread the earth.
world_title: The Valley of Tuwa Called Again
environment_concept: A high open place under a wide raised sky (79:28), a spring bubbling out of the ground into a green pasture (79:31), and mountains set firmly around the valley (79:32). The story of Musa and Pharaoh (79:15-26) is told only in the reading, not shown, and the Day of 79:34-46 is not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A sky platform, a spring and pasture, firm mountains around the valley.

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Musa and Pharaoh
story_library.children_narration: Musa was sent to Pharaoh with a message calling him away from arrogance and wrongdoing. Pharaoh rejected the warning. The surah invites us to learn from his example and to reflect on the creation of the heavens and earth.

world_idea.title: The Palace and the Cosmos
world_idea.description: Explore a historical Egyptian setting connected to Musa's story, then transition to an interactive astronomy environment.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: Musa and Pharaoh are not shown. The angels in 79:1-5 are not shown.
